label: Dividend
description: Cash payout to shareholders from profits

label: Bonus issue
description: Free shares issued proportionally to existing holders

label: Stock split
description: Share face value reduced, total count increases

label: Rights issue
description: New shares offered to existing holders at a discount

label: Buyback
description: Company repurchases its own shares from the market

label: Merger
description: Company merges with another entity

label: Demerger
description: Business unit spun off as a separate listed entity

label: Open offer
description: Public offer to acquire shares from minority holders

label: Bulk deal
description: Trade > 0.5% of equity in a single exchange session

label: Block deal
description: Large off-market negotiated trade between institutions

label: Shareholding change
description: Quarterly shareholding pattern update filed with exchange

label: Superinvestor buy
description: Notable investor discloses purchase

label: Superinvestor sell
description: Notable investor discloses sale

label: Mutual fund change
description: Mutual fund increases or reduces holding

label: Insider buy
description: Director / KMP buys shares in open market

label: Insider sell
description: Director / KMP sells shares in open market

label: Pledge
description: Promoter pledges shares as collateral for a loan

label: Pledge release
description: Promoter releases previously pledged shares

label: Acquisition
description: Promoter acquires additional stake

label: ESOP exercise
description: Employee stock options exercised by management

label: Contract
description: New client or supplier contract signed

label: Order win
description: New order received from a customer

label: Capex
description: Capital expenditure announced for new assets or capacity

label: JV / partnership
description: Joint venture or strategic partnership formed

label: New product
description: New product or service launched or announced

label: Expansion
description: Geographic or manufacturing capacity expansion announced

label: Plant commissioning
description: New manufacturing plant or facility goes live

label: Divestiture
description: Non-core business unit or asset sold or divested

label: Board appointment
description: New director or executive appointed to the board

label: Board resignation
description: Director or executive resigns from the board

label: Auditor appointment
description: New statutory auditor appointed by shareholders

label: Auditor resignation
description: Statutory auditor resigns — high-signal red flag

label: SEBI action
description: SEBI issues show-cause, penalty or trading restriction

label: Regulatory notice
description: Notice received from MCA, RBI, IRDAI or other regulator

label: AGM
description: Annual general meeting held or scheduled

label: EGM
description: Extraordinary general meeting held or scheduled

label: Rating upgrade
description: Credit rating improved by the rating agency

label: Rating downgrade
description: Credit rating reduced by the rating agency

label: Watch positive
description: Rating placed on positive credit watch

label: Watch negative
description: Rating placed on negative credit watch

label: Rating affirmed
description: Rating confirmed without change by agency

label: Rating withdrawn
description: Rating withdrawn — issuer request or non-cooperation

label: Quarterly results
description: Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 earnings release

label: Annual results
description: Full year audited earnings release

label: Provisional numbers
description: Unaudited early revenue or profit estimate

label: Restatement
description: Prior period results restated — accounting red flag

label: Guidance upgrade
description: Management raises revenue or margin guidance

label: Guidance downgrade
description: Management lowers revenue or margin guidance

label: Guidance maintained
description: Management confirms guidance unchanged at results

label: QIP
description: Qualified institutional placement to institutions

label: Preferential allotment
description: Shares allotted to specific named investors

label: NCD
description: Non-convertible debenture issued

label: Bond
description: Secured or unsecured bond issuance

label: IPO
description: Initial public offering

label: FPO
description: Follow-on public offering by existing listed company

label: Private placement
description: Off-market capital raise from select investors

label: Debt repayment
description: Loan or bond repaid ahead of or at scheduled maturity

label: Court order
description: Order from High Court or Supreme Court

label: Arbitration
description: Arbitration proceeding initiated, ongoing, or decided

label: Tax demand
description: Income tax or GST demand raised against the company

label: IBC filing
description: Insolvency petition filed under IBC at NCLT

label: Penalty
description: Regulatory or court penalty imposed on the company

label: Notice
description: Show cause or legal notice received

label: Settlement
description: Legal or regulatory dispute settled out of court

label: Acquisition
description: Company acquiring stake or entity

label: Sales initiative
description: Company launches a structured sales push, campaign, channel expansion or GTM strategy
